title: Design Google Drive
description: Design a cloud file-storage and synchronization service with resumable uploads, versioned metadata and explicit sharing permissions.
functionalRequirements: Upload, download and organize files and folders
Resume interrupted uploads without duplicating committed files
Share files with explicit read/write permissions and retain version history
nonFunctionalRequirements: Metadata operation server p95 below 200 ms in a region
Durable file contents and conditional metadata updates prevent silent overwrites
constraints: 5 million DAU, 1 million uploads/day and 5 million downloads/day with a 5x peak
Mean uploaded/downloaded file is 10 MiB, maximum 10 GiB; 4 MiB chunks are an example
Concurrent edits and revoked sharing permissions must have explicit semantics
outOfScope: Collaborative document editing or operational transformation

scale.assumption: Synthetic interview workload, not a claim about any named company's actual traffic.

storageEstimates.name: 30-day new-upload cohort, excluding older live files and versions

notes: The 30-day cohort is a capacity example, not a rule that all live files expire after 30 days.
Version history, deleted-file retention, indexes and existing live content need additional budget.
The example replication factor is a sizing assumption; an object store may use erasure coding instead.
